description: Messinaservizi Bene Comune publishes companies authorised to collect, sort and transport waste within the Municipality of Messina. The catalogue lists a 2021 PDF and georeferenced CSV, a March 2022 georeferenced CSV and a June 2022 spreadsheet. These editions describe service providers and their locations, providing actor and service-organization inputs for waste-logistics planning. They do not establish fleet size, vehicle capacity, routes, current authorisation or present operating status. The dated editions are kept together as one municipal directory series, without assuming that the company populations are identical. Access is public and free under Creative Commons Attribution, with an unspecified version. The metadata does not give a complete field dictionary or positional accuracy. Related records cover Messina's waste destinations and collected quantities; those are different objects, and the source does not supply a verified allocation of each company's loads to particular treatment sites.
